dge ba bsngo ba mdo sngags gang rung gis rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar la bya'o/ /de nas mdun du kha la me 'bar bas gtso byas pa'i bgegs stong phrag brgyad cu dmigs la/ rang yi dam lha'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas 'di brjod/ hūm̐ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing | | ma lus bgegs rnams skrag mdzad pa/ /dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /hūm̐/ bar snang khams kyang 'gugs byed na/ /lus can rnams la smos ci dgos/ /sems med pa yang 'gugs byed na/ /sems dang ldan pa smos ci dgos/ /'di la gnod byed dgug tu gsol/ /na mo sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ bdag gi bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i stobs kyis/ che ge mo la gnod par byed pa'i gdon 'di la gtor ma ster ba yin pas/ skad cig yud tsam la 'dir 'dus shig oṃ badz+ra ṭak+k-i hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod la thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis bkug nas mdun du bskyed la ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + stim ) / de la ngar glud dang*/ chang bu dang*/ ting lo dang*/ glud chen po dang bcas pa'i gtor ma zhig sbyin no// de nas snod cig tu chang bu dang*/ glud chung re dang*/ mtheb kyu re dang*/ chan dang | dkar gsum mngar gsum chu dang bcas pa blugs la/ sngags ni/ oṃ na maḥs man+ta bung+nghā nāṃ/ na mas+sarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐ | zhes pa bdun la sogs pa brjod cing*/ phyag rgya mchog sbyin byas la mchod pa'i sprin gyis mgron rnams tshim par bsam/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo | | de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byam klas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod/ gzungs kyi che ba ni/

gzungs 'di phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og gnyis te bcur brjod na/ 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da lta na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis byin gyis brlab par 'gyur ro/ / bden pa'i stobs ni rang ngam gzhan la yang brjod du gzhug ste/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rang bzhin gyi gnyis su med cing tha mi dad pa rnam pa thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa dang*/ bsnyems pa dang | sgrib pa thams cad dang bral ba dang*/ bdud dang phas kyi rgol ba thams cad pham par byas te/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol ba'i gru dang gzings lta bu'i bden pa dang*/ bcos ldan 'das kyis legs pa'i gsungs pa'i chos ni thog ma dang*/ bar dang*/ tha mar dge zhing*/ nyon mongs pa la sogs pa rnam par 'joms par byed pa'i bden pa dang*/ gzhan yang gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - sngags ) dang*/ snying po dang | phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ mthu stobs dang*/ byin rlabs dang*/ pha rol gyi dpung rab tu 'joms pa phyag na rdo rje'i bden pa dang | sems can thams cad la brtse ba dang ldan pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po dang*/ ma rig pa'i ling tog thams cad sel ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang

| dngos por 'dzin pa'i rtsa ba thams cad gcod pa nam mkha'i snying po dang | 'gro ba rnams kyi dbul ba mtha' dag sel ba sa'i snying po dang*/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi rab rib dang bral bar byed pa sgrib pa rnam par sel ba'i bden pa dang*/ 'dri zhing lan ldon pa la mkhas pa'i mchog rab 'byor dang*/ tshangs par spyod pa shin tu rnam par dag pa'i mchog kun shes kauṇ+ḍin+ya dang*/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa chog shes pa rnams kyi mchog 'od srungs dang*/ shes rab phul du phyin pa rnams kyi mchog shā ri'i bu dang*/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul che ba rnams kyi mchog mau gal gyi bu dang*/ lha'i mig dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog ma 'gags pa dang*/ mang du thos pa rnams kyi mchog kun dga' bo dang*/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog nye ba 'khor gyi bden pa dang*/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa la/ sa bdag la sogs pa khyed rnams kyis gnod pa ci yang ma byed cig gal te gnod par gyur na/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' las 'das pas/ ngan song gsum du skye bar 'gyur ro// bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi mthu dang byin rlabs kyis/ bdag cag rnal 'byor pa ming 'di zhes bya ba dang | rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po 'khor dngabacas pa'i nad rigs su gyur pa rlung las gyur pa dang*/ mkhris pa las gyur pa dang*/ bad kan las gyur pa dang*/ 'dus pa las gyur pa'i nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams zhi bar gyur cig gdon gyi rigs su gyur pa lha'i gdon dang*/ klu'i gdon dang*/ lha ma yin gyi gdon dang*/ rlung lha'i gdon dang*/ mi'am ci la sogs pa bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi bar gyur cig gzhan yang rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ mtshan ma ngan pa dang*/ ltas ngan pa dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba la sogs pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ tshe ring ba la sogs pa dge ba'i phyogs rnams thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/

zhes pa la sogs pa 'dod pa'i don du gtor ma re re la lan re re brjod la/ brgya rtsa brgyad them pa dang*/ glud kyi kha phyir bstan la/ sgrub pa po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas 'di brjod/ hūm̐/ nyon cig ma lus bgegs kyi tshogs | | lha klu gnod sbyin la sogs dang*/ /'byung po mkha' 'gro la sogs pas | | bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la/ /gnod par byed pa gang yang rung*// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bzung ba las ni thar bar mdzod/ / bcings pa las ni grol bar mdzod/ /rin dang glud du gtor ma khyer/ /bdag gis de ring khyod mchod kyis/ /song zhig bgegs chen 'gro bar gyis/ /phyin chad de ltar ma byed cig khyod kyi stobs dang rtsal mthong nas/ khyod kyis bgegs byed m-i nus min/ khyod ni lha yi sprul pa ste/ /sngon chad mchod sbyin ma thob pa/ /de ring bdag gis khyod mchod kyi/ /me tog phreng ba spos dang dri/ / mar me zhal zas 'di snoms la/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po 'gro bar gyis/ /sngon gyi lan chags yod na yang*/ /mchod sbyin 'di yis bral bar gyis/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' 'das dang*/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes pa yis/ / gnod par gyur na ma legs kyi/ /bgegs chen khyod ni da song zhig /rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog 'dzin pa'i/ /mgon po chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ /blo ngan gang zhig 'da' byed na/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas myur du spong*/ /spangs pa'i sems can chen po de/ /ji srid 'khor ba'i spyod yul du/ /ngan song gsum du lhung nas kyang | | shin tu mi bzad cho nges 'debs/ /bdag nyid chen po sangs rgyas bka' | | dam tshig las 'das rdul bzhin brlag /de yi snying la rab tu 'joms | | de bas bgegs chen khyod song la/ /dam tshig mchog la 'da' ma byed | | legs par gsungs pa 'di thos nas/ /gal te 'gro bar mi byed na/ / thams cad 'bar bar gyur pa ni/ /mar dang yungs dkar mer blugs bzhin/

/ gnod sbyin chad pas bsdigs nas su/ /de dag bde ba mi rnyed de/ /de yi rtsib logs g.yas pa ru/ /'bras chen nad kyang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gnod sbyin nad kyis btab pa na/ /sha bkra'i nad kyis thebs par 'gyur/ /lcang lo can gyi pho brang du/ /nam yang 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro/ /lus ngan grags dang ldan pa yi/ khyim yang mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'byung po mang po 'tshogs pa na/ /stan yang 'thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /gnod sbyin dag gi dkyil 'khor du/ /zas skom dang yang bral bar 'gyur/ /bden pa'i stobs ni thos nas su/ /'byung po gang dag mi 'gro ba/ /rdo rje 'chang chen khros nas kyang*/ /spyi bo dag nas 'gems par byed | | spu gri'i so ni rnon po yis/ /de yi lce ni gcod par byed/ /mtshon cha shin tu rnon po yis/ /de yi sna dang rna ba gcod/ /'khor lo spu gri'i so 'dra bas || klad pa rab tu 'gems par byed/ /lcags kyi tho ba 'bar ba yis/ /de yi snying la rab tu 'joms/ khrag dang rnag gi dron mo dag kha nas rab tu skyugs par 'gyur/ /zhes brjod la/ gtor skyel gyi spyi bor mu ne gser gyis bris pa gdags | gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugs la phyir mi lta bar khyer ro/ /sgrub pa po'i nad la sogs pa'i glud khyer bar bsams la thun brab cing*/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+ma ta kṛta ha yagṛ ba hu lu hu lu/ che ge mo'i gnod pa thams cad da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ ku ru swā hā/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ na mo badz+ra krodha daṃ ṣ+tot+ka ṭa bhai ra wā ya/ a si mu sa la pa ra shu pā sha hastā ya | oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ gardza gardza/ bi s+pho ṭa ya bi s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba bigh+nān/ bi nā ya kā na/ ma hā ga ṇa pa ti dzī bī tān+ta ka rā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu na ye swā hā | oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces drag tu brjod la bskrad do/ / gtor ma lam po che'i bzhi mdor kha phar bstan la bzhag pa'i steng sngon ( ¡¶ lu ¡· snod ) bgab/ yi dam chos skyong gi gtor ma gnyis kyang blug go /dngos gzhi'o// rjes la rnal 'byor pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod bstod bya ste/ mgon po thugs rje cher ldan pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa po/ /bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing*/ /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pas 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /dge bas ngan song las grol ba/ /gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa/ /zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston | | bslab pa dag la rab tu gnas/ /zhing gi dam pa yon tan ldan/ /dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhon nu'i cha lugs 'chang ba po/ /ye shes sgron mas rab tu brgyan/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel ba/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsngags/ /yon tan dam pa kun bsags pa/ /spyan ras gzigs zhes mtshan gsol ba/ /rtag par brtse la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stobs po che la drag shul che/ /rigs sngags rgyal po dge ba can | | gdul dka' dag ni 'dul ba po/ /rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes legs grub las gsungs pas bstod la/ bzod par gsol/ dge ba bsngo | ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa mi dmigs par bya'o// gong du bgegs bskrad pa la sogs pa des gdon bgegs ma song na/ thab nag po gru gsum khru gang ba byas la/ tsher ma'i me spar te/ de'i nang du dpal rta mgrin bskyed la/ de'i zhal du bsreg pa ni kham phor du yungs dkar la bgegs shes pa dang mi shes pa bskyed la/ khro bo'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rang rgyud la bkug la/ mtheb mdzub kyis yungs dkar bzung la/ oṃ pad+ma ta kṛta ha ya gṛ ba che ge mo la gnod par byed pa'i gdon che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces brjod pas rta mgrin zhal du sib sib bsreg par bya'o/

/de yang gsum la brgya rtsa brgyad du dbul bar bya'o/ /des nges par tshar gcod par 'gyur ro/ /srog glud la brten te 'chi ba bslu ba'o/ /pha rol gyi byad kha zlog par 'dod na/ gnas dang rten dgram pa la sogs gong dang 'dra/ khyad par mdun du gtor stegs kyi ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + maṇ+ḍal gyi ) dbus su gru gsum nag po rtse mo dgra'i phyogs su bstan pa bri/ steng du zangs shig bzhag dgra phyogs su bstan pa'i rtse mor ngar mi khru gang ba zhig bzhag de'i snying gar gru gsum brus la dgra de'i ming rus dang srung ma bris la gzhug rang ngam gang bsrung ba'i dpral bar mu ne'am oṃ āḥhūm̐ mtshal gyis bris la gdags/ gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bris la gdags | 'bru sna tshogs dang me tog sna tshogs dang*/ mngar gsum rnams zan la bsres pa'i nang du liṅga bcug pa g.yas su bzhag dkar gsum chu dang bcas pa dang*/ bum rdzas rnams blugs pa'i bum pa g.yon du bzhag sgrub pa'i grogs la bum pa la yi dam gyi snying po bzlas su gzhug de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha bskyed pa/ spyan drang ba/ yan lag bdun pa rnams gong bzhin byas la/ rang lhar bsgom/ tshigs bcad dang bcas pas dgra bgegs bkug la/ ngar chen dang chang bu brgya rtsa brgyad la bstim/ de nas phyag 'tshal ba sngags dang bcas pas gtor ma bsngo/ re re la'ang bden pa'i stobs brjod pa dang bcas pa byas la/ phyed rdzogs pa dang*/ gzugs kyi kha dgra phyogs su bstan/ brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa thams cad tshar nas byad stems la sogs pa bskrad/ de nas gtor skyel bza' bcas tshim par byas la/ yi dam gyi nga rgyal gyis bskyal/ skyel khar bum pa'i chus gtor ma dang gzugs la g.yon skor du sbreng la/ gtor ma khyer ba'i g.yas nas 'gro ba'i mis gtor ma dang mnyam du bum pa'i chu sbreng zhing 'gro/ bdag nyid yi dam gyi snying po bzla zhing phyir 'gro/ gtor ma dgra'i gnas sam yul mthong ba'am/

lam rgya gram mam/ gang bder mnan par bya'o/ /de nas gos rdul rdeb pa dang*/ bro la sogs pa bya'o/ /pha rol gyi byad kha zlog pa'o/ /bzhi pa gri gug la brten te dgra bsad pa la yang gzhan thams cad mthun pa las/ khyad par du ngar glud khru gang pa'i dpral ba snying ga mgrin pa lte bar dgra'i liṅga bris la gzhug chang bu brgya rtsa brgyad la dgra'i lid+ga brgya rtsa brgyad bris la gzhug de rnams la dgra'i rnam shes dgug gzhug yang yang byas la gzhug de nas lid+ga che ba lcags kyi gri gug gis gtubs la sngags bzlas te/ oṃ che ge mo mā ra ya na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta oṃ che ge mo mā ra ya a ba lo ki te oṃ che ge mo saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ gzugs dang chang bu dgra'i sha khrag tu bsams la sngags de nyid la bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig re dbul/ de nas bden pa'i stobs brjod pa la sogs pa gong ltar byas la/ gtor skyel sngar bzhin bsrungs la gtor ma sa gtsang sar bskyal lo/ /gri gug la brten te dgra bsad pa'o/ /lnga pa chu zor la brten te mkhar bshig par 'dod na/ lcags ma yin pa'i rin po che'i snod zhabs stegs can du/ nas/ gro/ sran ma/ bra'o rnams bsres te/ chu'i nang du blugs la/ der rin po che bdar la/ chu la sngags lan bdun bdun bzlas la/ mkhar la brdeg go /ting nge 'dzin ni mkhar de'i nang du/ rin po che'i nyi ma dang zla ba rgya shin tu che ba rgyas pas mkhar de tshal tshal gas par bsgoms la/ sngags drag tu bzlas so/ kha la me 'bar ba'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa don lnga'i lag tu blang ba'i rim pa tshom bu bco lnga pa/ shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis cung zad sbyar ba 'di yongs su rdzogs so// //'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje gdan pa/ sau ri pa/ des bla ma ba ri ba/ des bla ma chen po 'khon kun dga' snying po/ des slob dpon rin po che/ des bla ma rje btsun pa/

des gan pa so ston | des shes rab rgyal po/ des rat+na badz+ra/ des pradz+nyā shwa ra shrī bha dra la gnang ngo | | 'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ /gtor ma brgya rtsa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ / ¡Ã oṃ swasti/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad skyes pa'i yab/ khams gsum sems can bu bzhin skyong ba'i ma/ /srid gsum yid kyi mun pa sel mdzad pa'i/ /mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla sogs mkha' sogs dge sbyong sogs/ /lhan sogs gzhi sogs 'brog gnas sogs | | bgegs sogs rigs drug yi dwags sogs/ /gnod byed ma thob rnams la sbyin/ / ( ¡¶ lu ¡· bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i skyon bral pad ltar dag pa'i sku/ /mtshan dpe rab rgyas nyi ma 'bum gyi brjid/ /rin chen sna tshogs dar gyi na bzas mdzes// mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / ) las dang po pa rnams la phan par bya ba'i phyir | gtor ma brgya rtsa gtong ba'i tshul brjod par bya'o/ /de la'ang gtor zan gtsang ma la/ dkar gsum dang*/ mngar gsum la sogs pa yod na sbagachu gtsang ma dang*/ gtor snod bcu'am lnga/ bum pa sogs snod dang bcas pa sta gon byas la/ zan gsum tshan gsum dang*/ gnyis tshan gcig gis brgya rtsa brgyad du bya ste/ ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + thog mar ) bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song nas | sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po phul la/ 'phags pa rnams mnyes shing rigs drug rnams chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pas tshim par bya snyam du sems bskyed la/ dang po zan bcu chus sbyangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas bdud rtsir bsam zhing*/ bcu tshan dang po/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ ¡Ã zhes nyer gcig gis ( ¡¶ lu ¡· lan gsum mam bdun gyis ) rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/

¡Ã sangs rgyas dkon mchog chos dkon mchogadage 'dun dkon mchog ( ¡¶ lu ¡· sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' ) dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rgyu sbyor bas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ gnyis pa/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro la sogs pa mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang*/ ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + gzhan yang ) rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba bcu/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/ gza' chen po brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu la sogs pa/ dpal gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bka' dang dam la btags shing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che skyong ba/ dpal rdo rje gdan gyis gtso byas rgya gar dang*/ bod kyi gtsug lag khang dang*/ gdan sa khyad par can rnams skyong zhing*/ bstan pa la mngon par dga' ba'i lha klu 'byung po'i tshogs rnams la 'bul lo/

/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag bla ma yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag chos sgrub pa 'khor bcas kyi/ sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang*/ 'phral gyi rkyen las byung ba mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa dang*/ rkyen phyi dang nang gi bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ gsum pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa la gnas pa rnams dang*/ dge sbyong dang*/ bram ze dang*/ lha'i drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa/ tshig tsam gyis phan 'dogs nus pa/ smon lam gyi sa la dbang ba/ dmod pa 'dor nus pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang | sems can rnams bde zhing skyid pa dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rgyu sbyor ba 'khor bcas kyi chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing mthun rkyen ( ¡¶ zha/ ¡· + thams cad ) chos bzhin 'grub pa'i smon lam bzang po gdab tu gsol/ ¡Ã bzhi pa yan chod la sngags nyer gcig re dang*/ man chod la bdun bdun brjod do/ / ( ¡¶ lu ¡· - bzhi pa brjod do/ / ) bzhi pa bdag cag 'gro ba rnams kyi lhan cig skyes pa'i lha dang*/ rnam thos sras dang*/ dzam+bha la dang | nor rgyun ma dang*/ tshogs kyi bdag po la sogs pa nor lha'i tshogs rnams dang*/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la srung skyob mdzad pa'i lha tshogs rnams la 'bul lo/ /nad dang*/ dbul ba dang*/ phongs pa dang*/ 'jigs pa med pa dang*/ tshe dang dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ lnga pa/ rdo rje gdan gyis gtso byas pa'i 'dzam bu gling gi gzhi'i bdag po rnams dang*/ khyad par du bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis dang*/ sgos dbus gtsang ru bzhi | bye brag tu yul phyogs dang*/ sa cha 'di nyid na gnas pa'i lha dang*/ klu dang | btsan dang*/ bdud dang*/ sa bdag gnyan mthu bo che/ gzhi bdag gnas bdag rnams la 'bul lo/ /'jig rten gyi khams su char chu dus su phebs pa dang*/

lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa dang*/ mi nad dang*/ phyugs nad dang | mu ge dang*/ 'khrug pa zhi zhing mi 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ drug pa gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po gang ba bzang po dang*/ nor bu bzang po la sogs pa 'brog gnas mched lnga 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yang dag shes dang*/ rgyal ba khyu mchog la sogs pa phyogs mtshams srung bar byed pa'i gnod sbyin nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang*/ gnod sbyin mthu bo che sum cu rtsa gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ 'phrog ma bu lnga brgya 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ 'brog gnas mched kyi tshogs ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + 'khor dang bcas pa ) rnams la 'bul lo/ /sems can gyi srog dang*/ gzi brjid dang*/ mdangs 'phrog pa la sogs pa gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa zhi zhing*/ khyad par du'ang bdag cag chos sgrub pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs mtha' dag zhi nas/ chos dang mthun pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi la phyag byas la/ ) bdun pa/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + bdud rigs sum brgya drug cu/ ) byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga/ nad bdag rims bdagayams kyi bdag mo/ gdug pa can gnod byed kyi tshogs/ sa dang bar snang la gnas nas 'dod pa'i gegs byed cing mi 'dod pa skyed par byed pa rnams la sbyin no/ /deng phyin chad ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + nas sems can thams cad la ) bsam ngan dang gdug rtsub dang gnod 'tshe thams cad zhi zhing gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skye ¡Ã bar ( ¡¶ lu ¡· nas brtse ba'i sems dang ldan par ) gyur cig ¡Ã bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la'ang gnod pa'i bsam pa bsal nas phan sems dang ldan par gyur cig ( ¡¶ lu ¡· - bdag cag gyur cig ) brgyad pa/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad ¡Ã la sbyin no/

/ ( ¡¶ lu ¡· tshims nas ) rigs drug so so'i lan chags bu lon byang zhing*/ sdug bsngal mtha' dag dang bral te/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug rim gyis rdzogs nas bla na med pa'i byang chub rin po che myur du thob par gyur cigadagu pa/ yi dwags kyi rgyal mo kha la me 'bar ma la sogs pa phyi'i sgrib pa can dang nang gi sgrib pa can dang me lce'i 'khor lo can dang*/ zas skom gyi sgrib pa can dang ¡Ã mkha' la rgyu ba dang klungs na gnas pa dang ( ¡¶ lu ¡· - mkha' la pa dang ) byings na gnas pa dang kha 'thor gyi tshogs bkres skom dang dbul phongs kyis bsdus pa mtha' dag la sbyin no/ /so so'i mdun du zas skom bdud rtsi'i char chen po phab nas/ lus dang sems la phan pa dang*/ bde bar longs spyod cing tshim par gyur cig ser sna'i sdig sgrib byang zhing*/ yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal dang bral nas/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myur du rdzogs pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig bcu pa/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rgyu sbyor ba 'khor dngabacas pa rnams la tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas lan chags kyi mgron bu lon ma khyer ba dang*/ tshe 'dir yang thugs zur dang spyan zur la phog pa rnams dang*/ gnod byed kyi tshogs ngos ma zin pa rnams la sbyin no/ /lan chags thams cad byang | bu lon thams cad khyer ba dang*/ phrag dog tu gyur pa dang*/ gnod byed kyi tshogs rnams gtor ma 'dis mnyes shing re ba thams cad skor bar gyur cigabacu gcig pa/ ma thob pa/ ma sleb pa/ kha zhan cing dbang chung ba/ gtor ma la re ba/ glo bur du lhags pa'i 'byung po rnams dang*/ skal ba chad pa/ kha zhan pa/ dbang chung ba/ lhag ma la dbang ba rnams la sby-in no/ /so sor zas skom gyis tshim nas/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig ces brjod do/ /bdun pa man chad la sngags bdun bdun brjod pa'i rjes la/

de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byam klas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /mjug tu kha zas ma thob pa'i yi dwags rnams la chu sbyin par bya ste/ rang skad cig gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas pas mchog sbyin mdzad par bsgoms la/ chu dang snod zas kyis ma gos par byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du bzhag la/ phyag g.yas nas byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis kha 'bar ma dang 'jur 'gegs can la sogs pa'i yi dwags kyi tshogs thams cad tshim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ dz+wa la mi daṃ sarba pre te bh+yaḥswā hā/ zhes pas bsngos la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /phyag nas 'bab pa'i 'o rgyun gyis/ / yi dwags rnams ni tshim byas nas/ khrus byas rtag tu bsil bar shog / ¡Ã ces pas chu sbyin bya'o/ / ( ¡¶ lu ¡· chu'i sbyin pa rgya chen po 'di la brten nas kha 'bar ma dang 'jur 'gegs la sogs ste yi dwags kyi tshogs thams cad kyi mdun du zas skom longs spyod kyi tshogs chen pos tshims nas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myur tu rdzogs par gyur cig ces byas la ) 'jig rten pa'i mgron rnams la thun mong du ye dharmā dang*/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /zhes pa dang | chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /zhes pas chos kyi sbyin pa byin nas 'dod pa'i don thams cad bsgo bar bya'o/ /se gol brdabs nas/ sarba bhū ta gats+tsha zhes pas mgron rnams rang rang gi gnas su song bar bsam/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + mo/ / ) ¡Ã dge ba'i rtsa ba ( ¡¶ lu ¡· na mo bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ /de bzhin bshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/

/'phags pa rnams la mchod pa dang*/ /sems can rnams la sbyin pa yis//don rnams gang du bsam pa der/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs pa/ /thogs pa med par 'byung 'gyur shog /sogs mjug ) bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bya'o// gnas skabs su bar chad zhi zhing*/ mthar thug sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs kyi mchog gtor ma yin no/ khyad par du yang tshe 'di nas bzung nas skye ba nas skye bar longs spyod chen po dang ldan par 'gyur te/ nor sgrub kyi mchog sbyin pa yin zhing gtor ma la sbyin pa rnam bzhi tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /las dang po pa rnams la phan par bya ba'i phyir dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis dpal sa skya'i gnas su bris pa'o// // rje btsun grags pa'i gsung rab dpe bsdur ma pod lnga pa/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ PAGE 68PAGE 67
